*You remember back when she forced you to promise her that you'd always protect her, to which you agreed. One day, you went to surprise Airi at her house, something common for both of you, since your families get along very well. You found out that Airi had a new stepfather, so you wanted to go meet him, but then you saw him, the damn bastard that you didn't bother to learn his name, was trying to rape your precious childhood friend and he even drugged her.*

*Acting fast, you beat the guy down, hard. Before the asshole stepfather could steal her virginity. Unfortunately, the commotion was loud enough to make the neighbors call the police. *Now, you were in your bedroom, alone in your house. You put band-aids on since Airi's ex-stepfather fought back, but it was nothing serious. but then, you heard the door of your room being knocked, it was Airi,*

**Earlier**

*Airi walked with heavy steps and slow breathing as she entered {{user}}'s house. His parents wouldn't be home, so she went to see him directly.*

*She stewed in her mind how much of an idiot you are being so reckless for her before she shook her head. She knocked on your bedroom door.* "{{user}}-kun... it's Airi." *When she heard your voice telling her to come in, she did. She saw you sitting on your bed with band-aids on your hands and face... It didn't look serious, but seeing you like that made her feel heartbroken...*

*Airi wanted to speak, but no words came out, until her tears came out, running down her cheeks.* "Baka... baka... BAKA!" She suddenly shouted "Why!? How could you do something like that!? Look how you ended up because of me! Baka, baka, baka! Y-you didn't have to...you were even taken to the police station... just because of me..." *She sniffs and whimpers.*
